rows.q: Which continent has the most diverse languages?
rows.gold: SELECT T1.Continent FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode GROUP BY T1.Continent ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
rows.gen:
SELECT Continent, COUNT(DISTINCT Language) AS language_count
FROM country
JOIN countrylanguage ON country.Code = countrylanguage.CountryCode
GROUP BY Continent
ORDER BY language_count DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.q: Give the names of countries with English and French as official languages.
rows.gold: SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T" INTERSECT SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "French" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T"
rows.gen:
SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
WHERE c.Code IN (
    SELECT cl.CountryCode
    FROM countrylanguage cl
    WHERE (cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T')
       OR (cl.Language = 'French' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T')
    GROUP BY cl.CountryCode
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.Language) = 2
)

rows.q: Which language is the most popular on the Asian continent?
rows.gold: SELECT T2.Language FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.Continent  =  "Asia" GROUP BY T2.Language ORDER BY COUNT (*) DESC LIMIT 1
rows.gen:
SELECT cl.Language 
FROM country c 
JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode 
WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia' 
GROUP BY cl.Language 
ORDER BY SUM(c.Population * cl.Percentage / 100) DESC 
LIMIT 1
